description.value:
You create a localized mass effect gravity well that pulls nearby enemies in and suspends them helplessly.

You create a Singularity at a point within 60 feet. All creatures within a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-foot radius burst} centered on that point must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-singularity] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity's center.

Failure The creature is pulled to the singularity's center and becomes Restrained (Escape DC equals the creature's power DC). The singularity persists until the start of your next turn; you may Sustain it as a free action each round for up to 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure. Additionally, the creature takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage at the start of each of its turns while restrained.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
